paper_title: Search for Spectral Irregularities due to Photon-Axionlike-Particle Oscillations With the Fermi Large Area Telescope
suggested_experiment_name: Fermi Large Area Telescope (Fermi-LAT) NGC 1275 analysis
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper reports exclusion of couplings above 5×10^-12 GeV^-1 for ALP masses 0.5 ≲ m_a ≲ 5 neV at 95% confidence. The stated mass range 0.5–5 neV converts to 5×10^-10 to 5×10^-9 eV. Encoded as a horizontal line (mass-independent bound) spanning this range. The analysis searches for spectral irregularities in NGC 1275 γ-ray spectrum using 6 years of Fermi-LAT data. No evidence for ALPs found; limits are competitive with planned laboratory experiments (ALPS II, IAXO). Systematic uncertainties dominated by energy dispersion (−25% if broadened 20%) and intra-cluster magnetic field strength (±43% for σ_B = 20 µG). The paper also discusses a 'hole'-like feature in the exclusion region around E_crit ≈ 1 GeV where certain ALP parameters cannot be excluded due to rapid oscillations.
